label: a wall calendar.
why: A June 1947 wall calendar page hangs on a wooden wall and fills most of the frame; it does not move. The clip changes months with dark dissolves at 2.25 s, 4.25 s and 6.75 s, so no continuous stretch reaches 2 s except the opening June hold, 0.0 to 2.0 s; the smaller spike at 0.25 s shows the same page from the same view, with only a slight brightness change.
